Led by ninth-year head coach [[Chris Mack (basketball)|Chris Mack]], they played their home games at the [[Cintas Center]] in [[Cincinnati|Cincinnati, Ohio]]. They finished the season 29–6, 15–3 in [[2017–18 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to win the Big East championship. In the [[2018 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]] before losing to [[2017–18 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 1 seed in the West region. In the First Round, they defeated [[2017–18 Texas Southern Tigers basketball team|Texas Southern]] before being upset by [[2017–18 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] in the Second Round. On March 27, 2018, Chris Mack was hired as the new head coach of [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]], leaving Xavier after nine seasons.{{cite
